g.text: M04 · Four linked metabolite inputs · 53 train / 21 calibration / 32 held-out people
Points: held-out error. Lines: 95% person-bootstrap intervals from 1,000 refits.
This tests one estimator on two released microbial outputs; it does not rank study quality or measure treatment benefit.
